title: The Weight of Rain
subtitle: Poetry
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: A sequence of poems about weather, memory, and the long distances between people — rain as the language of everything unsaid.
style: Free verse, musical, image-dense. Each poem a small climate. Restraint over explanation.
characters: A speaker who addresses the absent, the weather, and the self.
setting: Interior and exterior weather; a city and a village held in memory.
notes: Open with a poem titled 'First Rain' about the smell of dust turning to earth. Each chapter a new poem or short sequence.
